Q decisions (up to six actual physics frames per decision)
Pre-update squared Bellman residuals averaged in fixed-decision blocks; low zero-reward loss can coexist with poor play.
Sample SD describes variation across independent chains, not confidence; bands are clipped at physical bounds.
